Joshua 14:6.bridge: The LORD tells Joshua to divide the land west of the Jordan among the remaining tribes by lot; Reuben, Gad and half of Manasseh already hold land east of the Jordan from Moses.

Joshua 17:14.bridge: Judah's borders and cities are recorded, then the territory given by lot to Ephraim and Manasseh, the two tribes descended from Joseph.

Joshua 18:10.bridge: Joshua sends three men from each tribe to survey the land and divide it into seven parts in a book, and they bring it back to him at Shiloh.

Joshua 19:51.bridge: Lots are cast for Benjamin, Simeon, Zebulun, Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and Dan, and Joshua himself receives the town of Timnath-serah in the hills of Ephraim.
